items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Williamson, on the last day of the convention and he came out, he said Fields... I said what's that, William? So he showed it to me

ctx.x: thing like that, although I had been on the board several years.

One year the vice president of our local, they had president, vice president and treasurer, by the by-laws, three would go. And so, this vice had open heart surgery and couldn't go, so they sent me in his place, and I'll never forget, we were in Hawaii and I was tickled to death to get that ride to Hawaii and so we went there and Williamson, on the last day of the convention and he came out, he said Fields, I don't remember the number of the resolution--he said, we got to see that this is passed today, and I said…
